title: Upcoming talk at IEEE MWN 2026
body: I will present “Rethinking Collaboration: Cost and Value in Fine-Tuning and Multi-Agent Reasoning” at the IEEE MWN Workshop on 6G for Ubiquitous Intelligence, University of Victoria, on November 11, 2026.
source: Current academic CV and official workshop page: https://oac.uvic.ca/mwn2026; checked November 10, 2026.

title: Social Circuits and CORTEX now on arXiv
body: Our preprints on multi-agent echo chambers and learning shared and specialized functions in dense language models are now available on arXiv.
source: Official arXiv records 2609.34444 and 2609.34449; both submitted September 28, 2026.

title: Joined Simon Fraser University
